newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss set terms on three-month money market claims.
newsitem.headline: Swiss set terms on three-month money market claims.

text.p: The Swiss federal government allocated 1,252.75 million Swiss francs in a new series 3.400 of money market claims yielding 1.25 percent, priced at 99.685.
The 91-day claims mature on November 20, 1997. Settlement is August 21, 1997.
The previous issue of three-month claims series 3.399 paid for on August 14 raised 794.95 million francs and was priced at 99.685 as well, to yield 1.25 percent annually.
